companyDescription: AI accelerator GPU + CPU powerhouse · MI400 HBM4 GPU H2 2026 · AMD Advancing AI event July 22-23 in SF = AMD's version of GTC · Hyperscaler AI share gains vs NVIDIA
priceNote: Rebounded to ~$570 after Jul 2 profit-taking (-4%) on high-multiple tech rotation. AMD Advancing AI Jul 22-23 in 16 days — MI400/Helios reveal is the next re-rate trigger. Wells Fargo PT $615 (+8%), Cantor $700 (+23%).
summary: AMD trades near $570 after a brief Jul 2 pullback from AI-rotation profit-taking — still up 280%+ over 12 months. The defining near-term catalyst is AMD Advancing AI 2026 (Jul 22-23, San Francisco): Lisa Su will unveil MI400 (432GB HBM4, Helios rack-scale) and hyperscaler adoption roadmap. Wells Fargo raised its PT to $615 (Jun 30) on server CPU revenue revisions; Cantor Fitzgerald holds $700. Q2 earnings Aug 4 is the follow-through catalyst.

catalysts.name: AMD Advancing AI 2026 — July 22-23 SF
catalysts.description: AMD's flagship annual AI conference at Moscone Center, San Francisco. CEO Lisa Su leads. MI400 full technical reveal (432GB HBM4, 31 TB aggregate memory), Helios rack-scale platform, ROCm software roadmap, and hyperscaler deployment timeline. This is AMD's GTC moment — the catalyst that could push AMD to $600-670.

catalysts.name: MI400 Production Shipments H2 2026
catalysts.description: AMD confirmed MI400 series for H2 2026 launch — 432GB HBM4 memory per GPU, Helios rack with 72x MI455X accelerators. Production shipments expected mid-2026. Microsoft, Meta, and hyperscalers are key early adopters.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Q2 2026 earnings expected August 4, 2026. Market expects MI300X AI GPU revenue continuation and MI350 ramp. If data center AI revenue beats $4B+, could push AMD to $600+. Strong Buy from 51 analysts.

risks: Consensus PT ~$508 is below current price $570 — stock priced on bull-case server CPU + MI400 adoption (Wells Fargo $615, Cantor $700)
NVIDIA CUDA moat: ROCm software ecosystem still 2-3 years behind NVDA — limits AMD's AI training market share ceiling
MI400 execution risk — any production delay announcement at the Advancing AI event = sharp reversal
AMD stock at ATH territory — any macro sell-off would hit extended names hard (-20% bear case)
FOMC July 29 is 1 week AFTER the AMD event — potential vol overhang
